text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio invites me to go visit a shrine
for New
Year's.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow... Look at all these people!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If this many people are coming here to
make a
wish, then the gods must have
their work cut out
for themselves!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's hurry up and get in line! At
this rate,
even the gods are gonna close
up shop!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew! We finally crossed that off the list!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming with me! I sure wasn't expecting it to be this crowded!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I was thinking about
coming
here with Prez...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But given what I was planning to pray
for, I
figured it'd be best to come with
you instead.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I prayed to become strong
enough to
surpass Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to enter senior year, so I'm
practically
right on Prez's tail!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna enter a bunch of big-league
races and
become the greatest racer of
them all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, what did you pray for? You
looked
pretty serious back there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow! You were thinking about me?
choice_data_list: Saying 'I'll take care of Teio's health', huh.
Saying 'I'll strive to improve Teio's abilities', huh.
Saying 'I'll level up Teio's skills', huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, I won't leave it to chance! Last
year made
me realize just how important
my body is!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't push myself and I'll make sure to
take
breaks! I'll show you how much I
can take care of
my health!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Help me get stronger?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, when you say it like that, I feel
like I need
to go at it even harder!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Very well. The great Teio shall grant
your wish!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Improve my skills? You mean like... work
on the
stuff I'm good at?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So you think that's really important for
me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, okay! I'll take your words to heart!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...You know, now I think of it, doesn't
your prayer
sound more like a promise?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. I guess the gods help those
who help
themselves.
choice_data_list: Because putting in the effort comes first.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then I wanna change my prayer to
"Enjoy
watching me as I surpass Prez!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We'd better get back in line! Come
on—let's go,
slowpoke!
